name: Generalized Linear B-Spline Wavelets
definition: A wavelet transform that generalizes lifted linear B-spline wavelets to slow growing refinement rules. It computes wavelet coefficients by predicting cell vertices via centroids and encoding the difference between centroids and actual cell vertex positions. Unlike SGS smoothing, original vertices are smoothed only by wavelet coefficients.
summary: Generalized Linear B-Spline Wavelets is a wavelet transform for progressive volumetric mesh compression that achieves superior low-bit-rate efficiency by smoothing vertices exclusively through wavelet coefficients rather than neighbor positions.
